title: EpisodeTrace
description: HAR-145: the causal trace of one DecisionEpisode as an ordered list of TraceSpans, source event -> evidence -> resolution -> graph mutation -> state -> precedents -> knowledge retrieved / applicable / cited (three separate spans, kinds knowledge_retrieved / knowledge_applicable / knowledge_used: retrieval is not influence, and neither is citation; the cited span carries influence_measured false because no measure of influence exists) -> candidates -> ranking -> Cliff message refs -> human interaction -> recomputed action -> knowledge mutation. Built by joining rows that already exist; it never recomputes an eval. Each span has a stable id (kind:primary-ref, the same on every read), refs to the underlying rows, and the ids of the EvalResults that judged that stage (eval -> family -> span mapping: contracts/evals/eval_areas.json family_spans). EvalResults of a family with no span of its own (the validation and safety families E18-E22) are listed in unassigned_eval_result_ids, so every result of the run is reachable from the trace. A TRACE is neither an EVAL nor a METRIC: operational metrics are served separately (GET /episodes/{id}/metrics).

spans.description: In causal order; seq is 1..n without gaps. Every kind appears at least once (cliff_message once per posted or reserved message kind); a stage the platform does not record, or that has not happened yet, is still a span with the matching status, never silently dropped.

id.description: The row's id, as text (a uuid, a bigint such as a graph diff id, or subject/surface/kind for a surface message).
kind:primary-ref (the first ref's id, else a fixed word); deterministic, so a deep link to a span survives a reload.

status.description: recorded: rows exist for this stage. pending: the stage has not happened yet for this episode (e.g. no human choice). not_recorded: the platform does not persist this stage (e.g. precedent retrieval, E5) or nothing was written for it; the span says so rather than inventing content.

summary.description: One factual sentence derived from the rows; never a model-written judgment.

evidence_refs.description: The evidence behind the stage, where the stage carries any (evidence, knowledge_applicable).

attributes.description: Kind-specific facts read straight from the rows (for example knowledge_ids on the three knowledge spans, from_version/to_version on state, order on ranking). Not an eval and not a metric.
